# Pixel Daylight Switch

> A dependency-free, draggable pixel-art day/night switch. A tiny animated world lives inside a refractive glass lens.

## Quick Start

### CDN

```html
<div data-ld-part="toggle-daylight"></div>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable@1.3.0/app.js"></script>
```

### NPM

- Install: `npm install pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable`
- ESM: `import PixelDaylightSwitch from 'pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable'`
- Named imports: `import { mount, unmount } from 'pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable'`
- CommonJS: `const PixelDaylightSwitch = require('pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable')`
- The runtime auto-mounts matching elements present when the script is evaluated.
- Call `mount(element)` for elements created later. Call `unmount(element)` before removing a mounted element.
- SSR-safe to import: DOM work only runs when `document` exists.

## Markup

- Mount selector: `[data-ld-part="toggle-daylight"]`
- The component creates its canvas, interaction button, and live status element if they are missing.
- Multiple independent instances are supported.
- The root element should have a measurable width. Its aspect ratio is 1.6439.

## Data Attributes

All attributes are optional unless stated. Numeric values that are invalid use the default. Numeric values with documented ranges are clamped to those ranges.

| Attribute | Default | Accepted values / range | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-ld-part` | required | `toggle-daylight` | Identifies a component root for automatic mounting. |
| `data-label` | localized label | Any text | Accessible label for the switch button. |
| `data-speed` | `9.5` | Positive number | Base motion response speed. |
| `data-refraction` | `1.24` | Positive number | Refraction strength of the glass lens. |
| `data-bezel` | `0.046` | Positive number | Glass bezel thickness ratio. |
| `data-start-night` | `false` | `true` / `false` | Start in night mode when exactly `true`. |
| `data-friction` | `0.6` | `0.1–0.9` | Release inertia damping. Lower values retain more glide. |
| `data-bounce` | `3.2` | `0–12` | Edge rebound impulse. |
| `data-dispersion` | `0.05` | `0–0.25` | RGB chromatic dispersion at the lens edge. |
| `data-shine` | `0.44` | `0–1.5` | Daylight lens highlight intensity. |
| `data-time-speed` | `1.0` | `0–8` | Pixel-world simulation speed; zero freezes world time. |
| `data-weather` | `default` | `default`, `snow` | Selects the weather effect. Unknown values use `default`. |
| `data-scene` | `countryside` | `countryside`, `japanese-street`, `apartment`, `seaside`, `mountain-cabin` | Selects the pixel environment. Unknown values use `countryside`. |

## CSS Custom Properties

Set these on the component root. Values shown are the runtime fallbacks.

| Variable | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ld-bg` | `#f5ecd9` | Component background palette input. |
| `--ld-surface` | `#8c9a62` | Surface and environment palette input. |
| `--ld-fg` | `#1b2146` | Foreground palette input. |
| `--ld-muted` | `#7f97b3` | Muted palette input. |
| `--ld-accent` | `#efa02c` | Focus and accent color. |
| `--ld-radius` | `9999px` | Interaction button corner radius. |
| `--ld-font` | `system-ui, sans-serif` | Component font family. |
| `--ld-space` | `8px` | Focus outline offset scale. |
| `--ld-shadow` | `0 8px 24px rgb(27 33 70 / .2)` | Reserved theme token; current renderer does not consume it. |
| `--ld-motion` | `200ms` | Focus outline transition duration. |
| `--night` | Runtime: `0–1` | Read-only live night intensity; 0 is day, 1 is night. |

## JavaScript API

### `PixelDaylightSwitch.mount(element)`

- Mounts one component root element.
- Returns a cleanup function when mounting succeeds; returns `null` if mounting fails.
- Idempotent: mounting the same element twice does not create duplicate instances.
- Example: `const destroy = PixelDaylightSwitch.mount(element)`.

### `PixelDaylightSwitch.unmount(element)`

- Stops rendering, removes observers and event listeners, and releases the WebGL context for that element.
- Call before removing the element from the document.
- Does not remove the root element itself.

### ESM and CommonJS

```js
import PixelDaylightSwitch, { mount, unmount } from 'pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable';

// Or CommonJS:
// const PixelDaylightSwitch = require('pixel-daylight-switch-gsvegetable');

const root = document.querySelector('[data-ld-part="toggle-daylight"]');
mount(root);
// Later:
unmount(root);
```

## Event

### `daylight:change`

- Dispatched on the component root when the switch reaches a changed day/night state.
- Bubbles and is composed.
- `event.detail.night` is a boolean.

```js
document.addEventListener('daylight:change', (event) => {
  const isNight = event.detail.night;
  document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', isNight);
});
```

## Rendering and Compatibility

- WebGL2 renders the refractive glass; Canvas 2D is used as a fallback.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Pauses unnecessary rendering when the page is hidden or the component is offscreen.
- No runtime dependencies.
